title: HLS Seek Restart Lifecycle
problem: HLS request identity currently does not model playback start position, so future seek requests would collide with or incorrectly reuse existing HLS sessions and artifact directories.

evidence.summary: Opened the HLS seek/restart lifecycle workstream and scoped the first slice to internal generation identity before runtime cancellation or FFmpeg seek flags.

Added HlsPlaybackGeneration to HLS request variant identity, threaded it through internal HLS source requests, preserved default request keys, and isolated non-zero seek generations in request identity and staging layout.

Made HlsAppService admission explicit: same-generation active duplicates conflict, same-generation finished outputs reuse, and different request keys for the same source supersede active HLS sessions by requesting cancellation before starting a new session.

Threaded HlsPlaybackGeneration into HLS FFmpeg command planning so non-default generations emit input seek, timestamp normalization, forced segment-boundary keyframes, and independent HLS segment flags while default generation preserves existing argv.
Exposed the minimal public HLS seek/restart surface with a start_position_ms playlist query, documented it in OpenAPI and generated SDKs, and closed client-player controls plus seek UX as follow-ons.

continue_policy.notes: The lane is closed. Future work should split follow-ons for client-player seek controls, heartbeat/seek UX coordination, source keyframe indexing or pre-roll optimization, HDR, downmix, and subtitle burn-in.
